---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[FEATURE REQUEST]"
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**What would you like to add or improve?**
Briefly describe your idea.
Example: “Let me adjust how far the video seeks when I scroll.”

**How would this help you?**
Tell us when you would use it or what problem it would solve.
Example: “When watching tutorials, scrolling skips too far. I’d like smaller jumps so I can replay a specific step.”

**How would you like it to work? (optional)**
Describe what you imagine.
Example: “A slider in the extension settings to adjust seeking sensitivity.”

**Screenshots or examples (optional)**
Add an image, sketch, or example from another app that helps explain your idea.

**Anything else? (optional)**
Share any other details.
Example: “I mainly use a MacBook trackpad, so separate mouse and trackpad settings would help.”

---
Please remove personal information and private links before posting.
